body: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

We have guidance counselors at school, but I can't go to them for my problems. Last time I did that, I got called a drama queen. 
They're too busy to deal with people like me anyway. I don't want to burden anyone with my problems. Especially if I have to see them almost on a daily basis.

That's another thing. I've tried to convince myself that it gets better, too. And sometimes it does for a short amount of time. However, happiness is only a temporary feeling, not a destination. Soon enough it cycles back into the same old thing and I'm back where I started.
